_comment: SATELLITE: start_size_scale shape study (plan-v2 B5). One geometry (virialized Option A lattice, GRF sphere support, bounded close-range law + 1 Gpc cap + adaptive substep threshold=2.0/substeps=8 -- MATCHED to core_v3 arm 05) x start_size_scale in {0.5,0.8,1.0,1.2,1.5,2.0} x a small M grid {35,100,300}, S co-fit [3..35] ternary. start_size_scale is a CONFIG-WIDE scalar in sweep.py (read via cfg.get in _make_sweep_config_for_cell), so each value is its OWN small arm (one arm per scale; the scale=1.0 arm is the byte-identical PF10 reference). This is a SECONDARY shape study, NOT the headline: particle_count is reduced to 1000 (below the 2000 production setting) for speed -- it isolates the a(t)-SHAPE move vs start_size, which PF10 shows is a real lever, and does NOT claim a converged chi2 band. vir_n_nodes=150 matches the core. Run in sequence by launch_sweep_detached.ps1 -IncludeSatellites; each arm writes results/ws1_sweep_<tag>.csv (resumable).

arms.isolates: virA GRF bounded+substep | start_size_scale=0.5 (smaller initial cloud)
virA GRF bounded+substep | start_size_scale=1.0 (byte-identical PF10 reference)
virA GRF bounded+substep | start_size_scale=2.0 (larger initial cloud)
